main.description: etzhayyim 信者 level advancement record. Per ADR-2605172600 § 'Levels'. Recorded on the member's PDS at the moment they call EtzhayyimMembership.advance(level, evidenceHash, memo). Levels 2..7; level 1 (Oath) is recorded as com.etzhayyim.apps.etzhayyim.oath instead.

levelNameJa.description: Japanese single-kanji name for this level. Canonical mapping: 2→修, 3→献, 4→証, 5→護, 6→議, 7→老.

evidenceUri.description: Pointer to evidence: at:// URI for an AT record / 'github:owner/repo@sha' / 'tx:0x...' / 'safe:0x...'. Any client-resolvable URI.

evidenceHashKeccak256Hex.description: keccak256(utf8(evidenceUri)) lower-case hex without 0x prefix. Used as the bytes32 argument to EtzhayyimMembership.advance().

evidenceMemo.description: Optional human-readable note (≤ 280 chars). Matches the memo argument to advance().

did.description: Member's DID. did:web:* / did:plc:* / did:key:* accepted.

didSignatureBase64url.description: DID-bound signature over (level || evidenceUri || advanceTxHash) bytes. base64url no padding.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID. 8453 (Base mainnet) or 84532 (Base Sepolia testnet).

advanceTxHash.description: 0x-prefixed Base L2 transaction hash of the advance() call.

smartWalletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed Smart Account address that signed the on-chain advance().
